title: Scream
synopsis: Woodsboro's grown up. You host a true-crime podcast about the original killings. A new ghostface debuts on your live stream. Don't pick up the phone.

nodes.text: Episode 102 goes live. The new ghostface enters the chat. Your moderators ban them. They come back.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Continue the show” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Your co-host Kira is, against your judgement, into it. She thinks it's an in-character troll.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Skeptical.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.

nodes.text: Detective Bailey, who appeared in three earlier Screams, is now a Lieutenant. She calls. She is, professionally, tired.

choices.consequence: “Cooperate” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Right.
There is no taking “Get a lawyer first” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A landline rings at 11 p.m. The number is from your old neighborhood.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Let it ring” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Kira's apartment is, suddenly, the scene of a thing. She is okay. The thing happened just before she arrived.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.
You commit to “Stay home.” The story records the instinct as “Pragmatic” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Sidney Prescott, retired, calls you. She has, she says, seen this pattern. She is, professionally, the expert.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
There is no taking “Politely thank her” back. Independence shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Your podcast numbers triple. Your sponsor wants you to lean in. You realize you are, accidentally, fueling the killer's brand.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Tone it down” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hybrid.

nodes.text: Ghostface starts a Twitter account. The bio is a single emoji. Six hundred thousand followers in three hours.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Discipline—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategic.

nodes.text: Your ex-boyfriend's brother is in town. He hates you, for unrelated reasons. He is, in a way you don't want to be true, also charming.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Confront him” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Bailey hands you a forensic report. The pattern of the killings matches not Ghostface 1 but Ghostface 3. Someone is, in fact, doing their homework.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Use that publicly” back. Bait them shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Discipline.

nodes.text: Your studio has invited a live audience for tonight's special. Bailey wants to cancel. Your producer wants to scale it up.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
You commit to “Scale up with security.” The story records the instinct as “Strategic” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Backstage you see, in the hallway, a glimpse of a face you recognize from the chat. You don't, at first, know from where.

choices.consequence: “Investigate quietly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Tactical.
“Tell security immediately” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Right.

nodes.text: Sidney shows up. The audience gasps. She is gracious. She is also armed.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Sense.
You commit to “Co-host with her.” The story records the instinct as “Equal” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The phone, on the live stream, rings. The producer, after a beat, puts it through. Ghostface, on the line, has questions.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Power—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The killer, on air, reveals they have your co-host's mother. The audience is in the studio. The clock is ticking.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Buy time—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Action.

nodes.text: Bailey has, mercifully, set a trap. The trap requires you to keep talking. The trap requires you to do exactly the thing you're terrified to do.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Lights out. The room is, briefly, a maze. You learn that everyone you trust is alive. You learn that one person you didn't trust is, in fact, the killer.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Stay still” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Two killers. The pattern, again. Ghostface motives are, this time, more banal than usual. The reveal is, by Sidney's calm voice, almost anti-climactic.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Trust Sidney.
You commit to “Improvise.” The story records the instinct as “Adrenaline” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The show is over. The bodies are off. The cameras are still rolling. You realize the entire night was, somehow, a podcast episode.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “End the podcast forever” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pace—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Sidney, on the way out, hugs you. She says, simply, 'Don't make a sequel.' You know what she means.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Make something different” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Pivot.

nodes.text: You find a good therapist. The therapist has, mercifully, no idea who you are. You like that.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
“Process privately” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Personal.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You retire from podcasting. You move out of Woodsboro. You become, weirdly, a person who teaches yoga. Sidney, of all people, comes to a class. She is, somehow, terrible at it. You laugh.
You start a new podcast about people who survived horrible things. The show is, in its quiet way, hopeful. It outperforms your old one. You are, mercifully, less of a brand.
Sidney becomes, in a strange way, your mentor. You meet for coffee twice a year. She gives you advice you do not, at the time, want to take but, in the end, always do.
